message: Astra: Could we set aside Alice's unresolved agreement-characterization question and keep the meeting moving from “I'll communicate these details to David andEmily.” by drafting that communication in a form you choose, not yet verified? What changes when Alice addresses the people assigned the work rather than Bob? Where would closer attention matter most? Why would additional thinking be worth its time compared with an informative draft now, and what uncertainty could make staying with the question more valuable? What evidence would justify your choice, and which next step will you carry out?
